name: Marine Engineering
title: Marine Engineer
introduction: Marine Engineers operate and maintain the engines and systems of ships. It is a unique career combining mechanical engineering with life at sea on long voyages.
whoShouldPursue: Students who want a life at sea

workNature.description: Marine engineers run ship engine rooms, maintain machinery and manage engine crews during voyages lasting months.

eligibility: Willingness to spend months at sea

stats.futureOutlook: Global shipping keeps growing and India supplies a large share of the world's marine officers. Tax-free sea salaries remain highly attractive.

steps.title: B.Tech Marine Engineering
steps.description: 4-year IME-approved degree with sea training.

steps.title: Sea Service
steps.description: Complete sea time and appear for MEO Class 4 certificate of competency.

conventionalOptions.title: Marine Engineer on merchant vessels
conventionalOptions.description: Engine room operations on cargo ships.

seo.title: Marine Engineer Career in India: Salary, Courses & Life at Sea
seo.description: Marine Engineering career guide for India — IME courses, sea life, tax-free salary and growth to Chief Engineer.

faqs.question: What does a Marine Engineer do?
faqs.answer: They operate and maintain ship engines and systems during voyages at sea.

faqs.question: Are marine salaries tax-free?
faqs.answer: Income earned on ships outside Indian waters for 183+ days qualifies for NRI tax status.

env: Months at sea on merchant vessels; on-shore marine firms between voyages

name: Mining Engineering
title: Mining Engineer
introduction: Mining Engineers plan and supervise the extraction of coal, minerals and metals from the earth. They combine geology, machinery and safety to run large mining operations.
whoShouldPursue: Those comfortable with rugged field sites

workNature.description: Mining engineers plan mine layouts, supervise extraction and ensure safety at mine sites.

eligibility: Willingness to work at remote mine locations

stats.futureOutlook: India's mineral demand for infrastructure and energy transition keeps mining engineers in steady demand, especially in Coal India and NMPS.

steps.title: B.Tech Mining Engineering
steps.description: From ISM Dhanbad and other institutions.

steps.title: Mine Manager Certification
steps.description: DGMS first/second class manager certificates.

seo.title: Mining Engineer Career in India: Salary, Courses & Scope
seo.description: Mining Engineering career guide for India — courses, salary, DGMS certification and PSU opportunities.

faqs.question: What does a Mining Engineer do?
faqs.answer: They plan and supervise mineral extraction while ensuring mine safety.

faqs.question: Are mining jobs only in remote areas?
faqs.answer: Mostly yes — mines are located near mineral deposits, though design roles can be office-based.

env: Mine sites in coal, metal and mineral belts; remote postings with stay facilities

name: Petroleum Engineering
title: Petroleum Engineer
introduction: Petroleum Engineers extract oil and gas from underground reservoirs using drilling and reservoir technology. They work on some of the most technically demanding energy projects.
whoShouldPursue: Those comfortable with rigs and remote sites

workNature.description: Petroleum engineers plan drilling, evaluate reservoirs and manage extraction at well sites and energy offices.

eligibility: Willingness to work at onshore/offshore sites

stats.futureOutlook: While the long-term transition is to renewables, oil and gas remain critical for decades. ONGC, Oil India and global firms continue hiring petroleum engineers.

steps.title: B.Tech Petroleum Engineering
steps.description: From ISM Dhanbad and similar institutions.

steps.title: Industry Entry
steps.description: Join ONGC, Oil India or service companies like Schlumberger.

seo.title: Petroleum Engineer Career in India: Salary, Courses & Scope
seo.description: Petroleum Engineering career guide for India — courses, ONGC jobs, salary and offshore life.

faqs.question: What does a Petroleum Engineer do?
faqs.answer: They plan drilling and manage extraction of oil and gas from underground reservoirs.

faqs.question: Is petroleum engineering still relevant?
faqs.answer: Yes — oil and gas remain essential for decades, and skills transfer to geothermal and carbon storage.

env: Onshore/offshore rigs and energy company offices; rotations at well sites

name: Textile Engineering
title: Textile Engineer
introduction: Textile Engineers work on the machinery, processes and quality of fabric production — from fibre to finished cloth. India is one of the world's largest textile producers.

workNature.description: Textile engineers supervise production lines, test fabric quality and improve manufacturing processes.

eligibility: Willingness to work in textile hubs

stats.futureOutlook: Technical textiles and exports are growing segments under government policy support, creating demand for engineers beyond traditional mills.

steps.title: B.Tech Textile Technology
steps.description: From textile engineering colleges.

steps.title: Industry Entry
steps.description: Join mills, export houses or technical textile firms.

newAgeOptions.title: Technical Textiles Engineer
newAgeOptions.description: Working on medical and industrial textiles.

seo.title: Textile Engineer Career in India: Salary, Courses & Scope
seo.description: Textile Engineering career guide for India — courses, salary, technical textiles and industry hubs.

faqs.question: What does a Textile Engineer do?
faqs.answer: They work on textile machinery, production processes and fabric quality in mills and garment factories.

faqs.question: What are technical textiles?
faqs.description: Textiles for medical, industrial and automotive use — a fast-growing segment.

env: Textile mills and garment manufacturing hubs (Surat, Tirupur, Ludhiana)

name: Aircraft Maintenance Engineering
title: Aircraft Maintenance Engineer
introduction: Aircraft Maintenance Engineers (AMEs) inspect, repair and certify aircraft for flight. Every commercial flight depends on their certification — making it a licensed, high-responsibility career.
whoShouldPursue: Those who want aviation without flying

workNature.description: AMEs inspect aircraft, repair engines and avionics and certify airworthiness before flights.

stats.futureOutlook: India is one of the fastest growing aviation markets, and every new aircraft needs licensed AMEs. The DGCA licence makes you globally employable.

steps.title: AME Programme
steps.description: 3-year DGCA-approved AME course with practical training.

steps.title: Licensing
steps.description: Appear for DGCA licence exams (B1/B2 category).

seo.title: Aircraft Maintenance Engineer Career in India: Salary & AME Course
seo.description: AME career guide for India — DGCA course, licence, salary and airline maintenance careers.

faqs.question: What does an AME do?
faqs.answer: They inspect, maintain and certify aircraft as airworthy before flight.

faqs.question: Is AME a degree?
faqs.answer: It is a DGCA-approved licence programme, not a traditional degree — but highly regulated and respected.

env: Airports, MRO facilities and airline hangars; shift work

name: Electric Vehicle Technology
title: EV Engineer
introduction: EV Engineers design electric vehicles — batteries, drivetrains and charging systems. India's EV transition is creating one of the fastest growing engineering segments.

workNature.description: EV engineers design battery packs, test drivetrains and develop charging infrastructure.

eligibility: Interest in automotive and clean energy

stats.futureOutlook: India targets 30% EV penetration by 2030. Companies like Ola Electric, Ather and Tata Motors EV are hiring aggressively, and the PLI scheme is boosting local manufacturing.

steps.title: B.Tech Electrical/Mechanical
steps.description: Core engineering degree.

steps.title: EV Specialisation
steps.description: M.Tech EV Technology or certification in battery/drivetrain systems.

seo.title: EV Engineer Career in India: Salary, Courses & Future
seo.description: Electric Vehicle engineering career guide for India — courses, battery technology, salary and industry growth.

faqs.question: What does an EV Engineer do?
faqs.answer: They design electric vehicle systems — batteries, motors, drivetrains and charging.

faqs.question: Which branch is best for EV careers?
faqs.answer: Electrical and Mechanical engineering are the main routes; mechatronics also works.

env: EV manufacturers (Ola Electric, Ather, Tata Motors EV), battery firms and startups

name: Space Technology
title: Space Technology Engineer
introduction: Space Technology engineers design satellites, rockets and ground systems. With ISRO's success and private players like Skyroot and Pixxel, India's space sector is opening up dramatically.

workNature.description: Space engineers design satellite subsystems, simulate orbits, test space hardware and support launches.

stats.futureOutlook: India's space sector opened to private players with IN-SPACe, and the National Space Policy targets massive growth. Satellite data, launch vehicles and ground systems are all expanding.

steps.title: B.Tech Engineering
steps.description: Aerospace/Electronics from IIST or other institutions.

steps.title: M.Tech Space Technology
steps.description: Specialise in satellite systems or propulsion.

seo.title: Space Technology Career in India: ISRO, Startups & Salary
seo.description: Space Technology career guide for India — ISRO jobs, private space startups, salary and education path.

faqs.question: How do I join ISRO?
faqs.answer: Through IIST placement or the ISRO Centralised Recruitment exam after B.Tech.

faqs.question: Can I work in private space companies?
faqs.answer: Yes — Skyroot, Agnikul, Pixxel and many startups are hiring engineers.

env: ISRO, private space startups (Skyroot, Agnikul, Pixxel) and global space firms

name: Mechatronics Engineering
title: Mechatronics Engineer
introduction: Mechatronics Engineers combine mechanical, electronics and software to build automated machinery and smart factory systems. Industry 4.0 runs on mechatronics.
whoShouldPursue: Students who like machines and electronics together

workNature.description: Mechatronics engineers design automated machinery, program PLCs and integrate sensors on factory floors.

stats.futureOutlook: Factory automation and Industry 4.0 adoption in India is accelerating — mechatronics engineers are central to this transformation.

steps.title: B.Tech Mechatronics
steps.description: From universities offering mechatronics programmes.

steps.title: Automation Skills
steps.description: Add PLC programming and industrial automation certifications.

seo.description: Mechatronics engineering career guide for India — courses, automation jobs, salary and Industry 4.0 scope.

faqs.question: What does a Mechatronics Engineer do?
faqs.answer: They design and build automated machinery combining mechanical, electronics and software.

faqs.question: Is mechatronics better than mechanical?
faqs.answer: Different — mechatronics adds electronics and programming to mechanical systems, ideal for automation.

env: Manufacturing plants and automation integrators; shop floor and design office mix

name: Environmental Engineering

whoShouldPursue: Students who want engineering with environmental impact

workNature.description: Environmental engineers design treatment plants, conduct impact assessments and monitor pollution.

stats.futureOutlook: Stricter pollution norms and ESG pressure are increasing demand for environmental engineers across industries and consultancies.

steps.description: Core engineering degree.

steps.title: M.Tech Environmental Engineering
steps.description: Specialise in water, air or waste.

seo.description: Environmental Engineering career guide for India — courses, salary, pollution control and sustainability roles.

faqs.question: What does an Environmental Engineer do?
faqs.answer: They design pollution control solutions and help industries comply with environmental standards.

faqs.question: Which industries hire environmental engineers?
faqs.answer: Water treatment, consulting firms, manufacturing and government bodies.

env: Consultancies, pollution control boards, industries and municipal bodies; site visits

name: Business Development

whoShouldPursue: Those who enjoy negotiation and travel

workNature.description: BD managers identify new clients, run outreach campaigns, negotiate partnerships and coordinate proposals.

stats.futureOutlook: Every growing company needs business development. IT services and SaaS companies especially value BD managers who understand technology.

faqs.question: What does a Business Development Manager do?
faqs.answer: They find new clients, markets and partnerships to grow company revenue.

name: Insurance Underwriting
title: Insurance Underwriter
introduction: Insurance Underwriters assess risks and decide insurance policy terms and premiums. Their judgement determines what the company insures and at what price.

workNature.description: Underwriters evaluate policy applications, set premiums and assess risk exposure.

stats.futureOutlook: Insurance penetration in India is low and growing — health, motor and life insurance demand keeps underwriters in demand.

steps.description: B.Com/BBA with insurance electives.

steps.title: III Certification
steps.description: Insurance Institute of India certifications.

seo.description: Insurance Underwriter career guide for India — skills, salary, certifications and career growth.

faqs.question: What does an Insurance Underwriter do?
faqs.answer: They assess risks and decide whether to insure, and at what premium.

faqs.question: Which certifications help?
faqs.answer: Insurance Institute of India (III) certifications are the standard.

name: Retail Banking

workNature.description: Retail bankers serve account holders, process loans, ensure KYC compliance and meet branch targets.

eligibility: Any degree + bank exams (IBPS/SBI PO) or campus hiring

stats.futureOutlook: Banking remains a stable career with clear progression through exams. Digital banking is changing roles but branch networks continue growing.

steps.title: Bachelor's Degree
steps.description: Any graduation with 60%.

steps.title: Bank Exams

eligibility: Any degree; MBA preferred for top funds
Market research and financial analysis skills

stats.futureOutlook: India's startup ecosystem is the third largest globally, and VC funds continue raising India-focused capital — analyst roles are competitive but rewarding.

faqs.answer: They evaluate startups for investment — markets, teams and financials.
